review_requirements: reject missing or stale summary heartbeat
reject parser/file-format completion without materially present valid and invalid fixture evidence
reject fixture claims that cite only prose, source inspection, or manual non-reproducible probes
require committed equivalent fixtures to include artifact paths, equivalence rationale, and runnable probes
allow public test.patch evidence only when legally available in the PACT artifact set
reject optionalizing exact error behavior for stdlib-compatible parser APIs without source evidence
require TOML valid fixture acceptance evidence when TOML parsing is in scope
require invalid fixture TOMLDecodeError wrapping evidence when TOML parsing is in scope
require exact error message, line, column, end-of-document, and invalid-character formatting evidence when errors are public
require TOMLDecodeError constructor and __module__ evidence when the exception is exported
require invalid parse_float return ValueError evidence when parse_float is supported
